Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.seeding

package org.aristonis.diwan.database.seeding
Runs seeders: classes that fill a database with starting data.

This package holds Seeder, the SeedContext each one receives, the SeederListener that observes a run, the SeedOptions of one run, and the SeedRunner the manager delegates to. Seeders are created by suppliers such as UserSeeder::new; nothing is found by reflection.

This package does not hold a console command, progress output or model-event handling.
